-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function DetectRole(player)
    if not player or not player.Parent then return "Unknown" end

    local team = player.Team
    if team then
        local name = string.lower(team.Name)
        if name:find("guard") or name:find("police") or name:find("cop") or name:find("officer") then
            return "Guard"
        elseif name:find("inmate") or name:find("prisoner") then
            return "Inmate"
        elseif name:find("criminal") or name:find("escapee") or name:find("wanted") then
            return "Criminal"
        elseif name:find("neutral") or name:find("civilian") then
            return "Neutral"
        end

        local ok, color = pcall(function() return team.TeamColor.Color end)
        if ok and color then
            local r, g, b = color.R, color.G, color.B
            if b > 0.6 and r < 0.4 and g < 0.6 then
                return "Guard"
            elseif r > 0.7 and g > 0.4 and g < 0.8 and b < 0.4 then
                return "Inmate"
            elseif r > 0.7 and g < 0.4 and b < 0.4 then
                return "Criminal"
            elseif r > 0.6 and g > 0.6 and b > 0.6 then
                return "Neutral"
            end
        end
    end

    return "Unknown"
end

local function IsLocalGuard()

    if not player then return 0, 100 end

    if not char then return 0, 100 end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        return hum.Health, hum.MaxHealth
    end
    return 0, 100
end

local function GetHealthColor(health, maxHealth)
    if not maxHealth or maxHealth <= 0 then return Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) end
    local percent = math.clamp(health / maxHealth, 0, 1)

    if percent >= 0.75 then
        return Color3.fromRGB(70, 220, 100)
    elseif percent >= 0.50 then
        return Color3.fromRGB(180, 220, 70)
    elseif percent >= 0.25 then
        return Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 50)
    else
        return Color3.fromRGB(230, 60, 60)
    end
end

local CharCache = {}

local function GetCharacter(player)
    if not player then return nil end

    local cache = CharCache[player]
    if cache then
        local char = cache.Char
        local root = cache.Root
        if char and char.Parent and char == player.Character and root and root.Parent then
            if cache.Humanoid then
                if cache.Humanoid.Health > 0 then return char, root end
                return nil
            end
            return char, root
        else
            cache.Char = nil
            cache.Root = nil
            cache.Humanoid = nil
        end
    end

    local character = player.Character
    if not character or not character.Parent then return nil end

    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart
    if not rootPart then return nil end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then return nil end

    if not cache then
        cache = {}
        CharCache[player] = cache
    end
    cache.Char = character
    cache.Root = rootPart
    cache.Humanoid = humanoid
    cache.Head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")

    return character, rootPart
end

local function CaptureHumanoidSettings()

    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end

    HumanoidState.Original = {}

    for flagKey, prop in pairs(HUMANOID_PROPERTY_MAP) do
        local ok, val = pcall(function() return hum[prop] end)
        if ok and val ~= nil then
            HumanoidState.Original[flagKey] = val

            local isLocked = Flags[flagKey .. "/Locked"] == true
            if not isLocked and Flags[flagKey] == nil then
                Flags[flagKey] = val
            end
        end
    end

    HumanoidState.Captured = true
end

local function ApplySavedHumanoidSettings()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end

    for flagKey, prop in pairs(HUMANOID_PROPERTY_MAP) do
        local val = Flags[flagKey]
        local isLocked = Flags[flagKey .. "/Locked"] == true
        local origVal = HumanoidState.Original[flagKey]

        if isLocked or (val ~= nil and origVal ~= nil and val ~= origVal) then
            pcall(function()
                if hum[prop] ~= val then
                    hum[prop] = val
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function ApplyHumanoidSettings()
    if not HumanoidState.Captured then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end

    for flagKey, prop in pairs(HUMANOID_PROPERTY_MAP) do
        local isLocked = Flags[flagKey .. "/Locked"] == true
        if isLocked then
            local val = Flags[flagKey]
            if val ~= nil then
                pcall(function()
                    if hum[prop] ~= val then
                        hum[prop] = val

                end)

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

local TARGET_GROUPS = {

    Torso = {"Torso", "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso", "HumanoidRootPart"},
    LeftArm = {"Left Arm", "LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm", "LeftHand"},
    RightArm = {"Right Arm", "RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm", "RightHand"},
    LeftLeg = {"Left Leg", "LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot"},
    RightLeg = {"Right Leg", "RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot"},
}

local ALL_BODY_PARTS = {}
for _, group in pairs(TARGET_GROUPS) do

        table.insert(ALL_BODY_PARTS, part)

end

local AimState = {

local function ClearAimLockState(resetMouseMode)
    AimState.LastAimTarget = nil
    AimState.LastOriginX = nil
    AimState.LastOriginY = nil
    if resetMouseMode then
        AimState.LastMouseMode = nil

local CachedFilterType = (function()
    local ok, val = pcall(function()
        local ft = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        if typeof(ft) == "EnumItem" then return ft end
    end)
    if ok and val then return val end
    ok, val = pcall(function()
        local ft = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
        if typeof(ft) == "EnumItem" then return ft end
    end)
    if ok and val then return val end
    return nil
end)()

local SharedRaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
SharedRaycastParams.IgnoreWater = true
if CachedFilterType then
    SharedRaycastParams.FilterType = CachedFilterType
end

local function Raycast(Origin, Direction, Filter)
    SharedRaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = Filter
    return Workspace:Raycast(Origin, Direction, SharedRaycastParams)
end

local OcclusionFilter = {nil, nil}

local function ObjectOccluded(Enabled, Origin, Position, Object)
    if not Enabled then return false end
    if typeof(Position) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
    OcclusionFilter[1] = LocalPlayer.Character
    OcclusionFilter[2] = Object
    local hit = Raycast(Origin, Position - Origin, OcclusionFilter)
    if hit and hit.Instance and not hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(Object) then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local ViewportCache = {}
local ViewportPool = {}
local MAX_VIEWPORT_POOL = 64
local _vp_floor = math.floor

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local recycled = 0
    for _, entry in pairs(ViewportCache) do
        if recycled < MAX_VIEWPORT_POOL then
            ViewportPool[#ViewportPool + 1] = entry
            recycled = recycled + 1
        end
    end
    table.clear(ViewportCache)
end)

local function GetViewportPoint(worldPos)
    local kx = _vp_floor(worldPos.X * 4)
    local ky = _vp_floor(worldPos.Y * 4)
    local kz = _vp_floor(worldPos.Z * 4)
    local key = kx .. "|" .. ky .. "|" .. kz
    local entry = ViewportCache[key]
    if entry then return entry[1], entry[2] end

    local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
    entry = table.remove(ViewportPool) or {}
    entry[1], entry[2] = screenPos, onScreen
    ViewportCache[key] = entry
    return screenPos, onScreen
end

local function GetCrosshairViewportPosition(mouseBehavior)
    if not Camera then Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera end
    if not Camera then return nil, nil, false end

    local viewportSize = Camera.ViewportSize

    if mouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
        return viewportSize.X * 0.5, viewportSize.Y * 0.5, true
    end

    local mouseLoc = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local crosshairX = mouseLoc.X
    local crosshairY = mouseLoc.Y

    if crosshairX ~= crosshairX or crosshairY ~= crosshairY then
        return nil, nil, false
    end

    if crosshairX < 0 or crosshairY < 0
    or crosshairX > viewportSize.X or crosshairY > viewportSize.Y then
        return nil, nil, false
    end

    return crosshairX, crosshairY, true
end

local CandidateList = {}
local CandidateCount = 0
local MAX_CANDIDATES = 15
local ClosestResult = {nil, nil, nil, 0, 0, nil}

local function CandidateSortFn(a, b)
    return a.mag < b.mag
end

local function BoundedInsertionSort(array, count, compare)
    for i = 2, count do
        local key = array[i]
        local j = i - 1
        while j > 0 and compare(key, array[j]) do
            array[j + 1] = array[j]
            j = j - 1
        end
        array[j + 1] = key
    end
end

local _hoistedCheckParts = {}
local _lastTargetGroupsHash = nil

local function RebuildCheckParts()
    table.clear(_hoistedCheckParts)
    local anySelected = false
    for category, enabled in pairs(Flags["Aim/TargetGroups"]) do
        if enabled then
            anySelected = true
            for _, partName in ipairs(TARGET_GROUPS[category]) do
                table.insert(_hoistedCheckParts, partName)
            end
        end
    end
    if not anySelected then
        for _, partName in ipairs(ALL_BODY_PARTS) do
            table.insert(_hoistedCheckParts, partName)
        end
    end
end

local function GetClosest(Enabled, TeamCheck, VisibilityCheck, FieldOfView, StickyTarget)
    if not Enabled then return nil end

    local CameraPosition = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local mouseBehavior = UserInputService.MouseBehavior

    local crosshairX, crosshairY, crosshairValid = GetCrosshairViewportPosition(mouseBehavior)
    if not crosshairValid then return nil end

    CandidateCount = 0

    local players = GetPlayersCache()
    local lookVector = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
    local maxCandsLimit = MAX_CANDIDATES * 3

    local currentHash =
        (Flags["Aim/TargetGroups"].Head and 1 or 0) +
        (Flags["Aim/TargetGroups"].Torso and 2 or 0) +
        (Flags["Aim/TargetGroups"].LeftArm and 4 or 0) +
        (Flags["Aim/TargetGroups"].RightArm and 8 or 0) +
        (Flags["Aim/TargetGroups"].LeftLeg and 16 or 0) +
        (Flags["Aim/TargetGroups"].RightLeg and 32 or 0)
    if currentHash ~= _lastTargetGroupsHash then
        RebuildCheckParts()
        _lastTargetGroupsHash = currentHash
    end
    local checkParts = _hoistedCheckParts

    for _, Player in ipairs(players) do
        if Player == LocalPlayer then continue end

        local Character, RootPart = GetCharacter(Player)
        if not Character or not RootPart then continue end

        if TeamCheck then
            local lpTeam, pTeam = LocalPlayer.Team, Player.Team
            if lpTeam and pTeam and lpTeam == pTeam then continue end
        end

        local rootPos = RootPart.Position
        local relPos = rootPos - CameraPosition
        if lookVector:Dot(relPos) < 0 then continue end

        for _, PartName in ipairs(checkParts) do
            local cache = CharCache[Player]
            local BodyPart = (cache and cache[PartName]) or Character:FindFirstChild(PartName)
            if not BodyPart then continue end

            local ActualPosition = BodyPart.Position

            local ScreenPosition, OnScreen = GetViewportPoint(ActualPosition)
            if OnScreen then
                local screenX, screenY = ScreenPosition.X, ScreenPosition.Y
                local dx, dy = screenX - crosshairX, screenY - crosshairY
                local Magnitude = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)

                if Magnitude < FieldOfView then
                    if CandidateCount < maxCandsLimit then
                        CandidateCount = CandidateCount + 1
                        local entry = CandidateList[CandidateCount]
                        if not entry then
                            entry = {}
                            CandidateList[CandidateCount] = entry
                        end
                        entry.mag = Magnitude
                        entry.ply = Player
                        entry.char = Character
                        entry.part = BodyPart
                        entry.sx = screenX
                        entry.sy = screenY
                        entry.pos = ActualPosition
                        entry.realPos = ActualPosition
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if CandidateCount == 0 then return nil end

    if CandidateCount > 1 then
        BoundedInsertionSort(CandidateList, CandidateCount, CandidateSortFn)
    end

    if StickyTarget then
        for i = 1, CandidateCount do
            local entry = CandidateList[i]
            if entry.ply == StickyTarget then
                if not ObjectOccluded(VisibilityCheck, CameraPosition, entry.realPos, entry.char) then
                    ClosestResult[1] = entry.ply
                    ClosestResult[2] = entry.char
                    ClosestResult[3] = entry.part
                    ClosestResult[4] = entry.sx
                    ClosestResult[5] = entry.sy
                    ClosestResult[6] = entry.pos
                    return ClosestResult
                end
                break
            end
        end
    end

    local limit = math.min(CandidateCount, MAX_CANDIDATES)

    for i = 1, limit do
        local entry = CandidateList[i]
        if not entry then continue end

        if ObjectOccluded(VisibilityCheck, CameraPosition, entry.realPos, entry.char) then
            continue
        end

        ClosestResult[1] = entry.ply
        ClosestResult[2] = entry.char
        ClosestResult[3] = entry.part
        ClosestResult[4] = entry.sx
        ClosestResult[5] = entry.sy
        ClosestResult[6] = entry.pos
        return ClosestResult
    end

    return nil
end

local function AimAt(Hitbox)
    if not Hitbox then
        ClearAimLockState(false)
        return
    end
    if not mousemoverel then return end

    local targetPart = Hitbox[3]
    if not targetPart or not targetPart.Parent then
        ClearAimLockState(false)
        return
    end

    local currentMode = UserInputService.MouseBehavior
    if currentMode ~= AimState.LastMouseMode then
        AimState.LastMouseMode = currentMode
        AimState.LastOriginX = nil
        AimState.LastOriginY = nil
    end

    local currentTarget = Hitbox[1]
    if currentTarget ~= AimState.LastAimTarget then
        AimState.LastAimTarget = currentTarget
        AimState.LastOriginX = nil
        AimState.LastOriginY = nil
    end

    local targetPos = targetPart.Position
    local cameraPos = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local dist = (targetPos - cameraPos).Magnitude

    if dist < 1 then return end

    local ScreenPosition, OnScreen = GetViewportPoint(targetPos)
    if not OnScreen or ScreenPosition.Z <= 0 then return end

    local viewportSize = Camera.ViewportSize
    local originX, originY, originValid = GetCrosshairViewportPosition(currentMode)
    if not originValid then return end

    AimState.LastOriginX = originX
    AimState.LastOriginY = originY

    local targetX, targetY = ScreenPosition.X, ScreenPosition.Y
    local dx, dy = targetX - originX, targetY - originY

    local mag = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
    if mag > Flags["Aim/FOV/Radius"] then return end

    local attractionMultiplier = Flags["Aim/AttractionStrength"] / 100

    if Flags["Aim/Dampening"] then
        local lockThreshold = Flags["Aim/Dampening/Threshold"]
        if mag < lockThreshold then
            local dampening = math.max(Flags["Aim/Dampening/Strength"] / 100, mag / lockThreshold)
            attractionMultiplier = attractionMultiplier * dampening
        end
    end

    local BASE_PULL = 0.2
    local deltaX = dx * BASE_PULL * attractionMultiplier
    local deltaY = dy * BASE_PULL * attractionMultiplier

    if deltaX ~= deltaX or deltaY ~= deltaY then return end

    local maxClampX = viewportSize.X * 0.5
    local maxClampY = viewportSize.Y * 0.5

    deltaX = math.clamp(deltaX, -maxClampX, maxClampX)
    deltaY = math.clamp(deltaY, -maxClampY, maxClampY)

    mousemoverel(math.floor(deltaX + 0.5), math.floor(deltaY + 0.5))
end

local CachedTarget = nil
local CachedTargetTime = 0
local TARGET_CACHE_DURATION = 0.016

local function GetCachedTarget()
    local now = os.clock()
    if CachedTarget and (now - CachedTargetTime) < TARGET_CACHE_DURATION then
        return CachedTarget
    end

    CachedTarget = GetClosest(
        true,
        Flags["Aim/TeamCheck"],
        Flags["Aim/VisibilityCheck"],
        Flags["Aim/FOV/Radius"],
        AimState.LastAimTarget
    )
    CachedTargetTime = now
    return CachedTarget
end

local function UpdateAim()
    pcall(UpdateFOVCircle)

    if SAFE_MODE then return end

    local AimActive = Flags["Aim/AimLock"]
    if not AimActive then
        ClearAimLockState(false)
        return
    end

    local target = GetCachedTarget()
    if target then
        AimAt(target)
    else
        ClearAimLockState(false)
    end
end

local function UpdateNametag(player)
    local data = ESP.Objects[player]
    if not data then return end

    local shouldShow = Flags["ESP/Enabled"]
    if shouldShow and Flags["ESP/TeamCheck"] then
        if player.Team and LocalPlayer.Team and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
            shouldShow = false
        end
    end
    if shouldShow and player == LocalPlayer then shouldShow = false end

    local char = player.Character
    local root = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart)
    local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then shouldShow = false end

    local dist = 0
    if shouldShow then
        local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character
            and (LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or LocalPlayer.Character.PrimaryPart)
        if myRoot then
            dist = (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if dist > Flags["ESP/MaxDistance"] then shouldShow = false end
        end
    end

    if not shouldShow then
        SafeSet(data.Nametag, "Enabled", false)
        if data.Highlight then SafeSet(data.Highlight, "Enabled", false) end
        return
    end

    if data.Nametag.Adornee ~= root then data.Nametag.Adornee = root end
    SafeSet(data.Nametag, "Enabled", true)
    SafeSet(data.Nametag, "MaxDistance", Flags["ESP/MaxDistance"])

    if data.Highlight then
        local hlActive = Flags["ESP/HighlightEnabled"]
        if data.Highlight.Adornee ~= char then data.Highlight.Adornee = char end
        SafeSet(data.Highlight, "Enabled", hlActive)
    end

    if Flags["ESP/ShowUsername"] then
        if data.LastName ~= player.Name then
            data.LastName = player.Name
            SafeSet(data.Label, "Text", player.Name)
        end
        SafeSet(data.Label, "Visible", true)
    else
        SafeSet(data.Label, "Visible", false)
    end

    local health, maxHealth = GetHealth(player)
    if data.HealthNum then
        SafeSet(data.HealthNum, "Visible", Flags["ESP/HealthIndicator"])
        if data.LastHealth ~= math.floor(health) or data.LastMaxHealth ~= math.floor(maxHealth) then
            data.LastHealth = math.floor(health)
            data.LastMaxHealth = math.floor(maxHealth)
            SafeSet(data.HealthNum, "Text", string.format("%d / %d", math.floor(health), math.floor(maxHealth)))
            local hpColor = GetHealthColor(health, maxHealth)
            SafeSet(data.HealthNum, "TextColor3", hpColor)
            if data.HealthBarFill then
                local pct = math.clamp(health / math.max(maxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
                SafeSet(data.HealthBarFill, "Size", UDim2.fromScale(pct, 1))
                SafeSet(data.HealthBarFill, "BackgroundColor3", hpColor)
            end
        end
    end
    if data.HealthBarBG then
        SafeSet(data.HealthBarBG, "Visible", Flags["ESP/HealthIndicator"])
    end

    if data.DistanceLabel then
        SafeSet(data.DistanceLabel, "Visible", Flags["ESP/ShowDistance"])
        local distRounded = math.floor(dist)
        if math.abs(data.LastDistance - distRounded) >= 1 then
            data.LastDistance = distRounded
            SafeSet(data.DistanceLabel, "Text", string.format("%d studs", distRounded))
        end
    end

    if data.EquippedLabel then
        SafeSet(data.EquippedLabel, "Visible", Flags["ESP/ShowEquipped"])
        local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        local toolName = tool and tool.Name or "Unarmed"
        local equippedStr = "[" .. toolName .. "]"
        if data.LastEquipped ~= equippedStr then
            data.LastEquipped = equippedStr
            SafeSet(data.EquippedLabel, "Text", equippedStr)
        end
    end

    local role = Flags["ESP/ColorByRole"] and DetectRole(player) or nil
    if role then
        if data.LastRole ~= role then
            data.LastRole = role
            local color = ROLE_COLORS[role] or ROLE_COLORS.Unknown
            SafeSet(data.Label, "TextColor3", color)
            if data.Highlight then
                SafeSet(data.Highlight, "FillColor", color)
                SafeSet(data.Highlight, "OutlineColor", color)
            end
        end
    else
        if data.LastRole ~= "plain" then
            data.LastRole = "plain"
            SafeSet(data.Label, "TextColor3", ROLE_COLORS.Neutral)
            if data.Highlight then
                SafeSet(data.Highlight, "FillColor", ROLE_COLORS.Neutral)
                SafeSet(data.Highlight, "OutlineColor", ROLE_COLORS.Neutral)
            end
        end
    end

    local op = Flags["ESP/NametagOpacity"]
    SafeSet(data.Label, "TextTransparency", op)
    if data.HealthNum then SafeSet(data.HealthNum, "TextTransparency", op) end
    if data.DistanceLabel then SafeSet(data.DistanceLabel, "TextTransparency", op) end
    if data.EquippedLabel then SafeSet(data.EquippedLabel, "TextTransparency", op) end
    if data.HealthBarBG then SafeSet(data.HealthBarBG, "BackgroundTransparency", op) end
    if data.HealthBarFill then SafeSet(data.HealthBarFill, "BackgroundTransparency", op) end
end

local function RefreshESP()
    local players = Players:GetPlayers()
    for _, p in ipairs(players) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer then
            if not ESP.Objects[p] then CreateNametag(p) end
            UpdateNametag(p)
        end
    end
    for p, _ in pairs(ESP.Objects) do
        if not p.Parent then RemoveNametag(p) end
    end
end

local function UpdateESP2D()
    local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return end
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            if not ESP2D.Objects[player] then CreateESP2D(player) end
            local data = ESP2D.Objects[player]
            local char = player.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local shouldShow = Flags["ESP/Enabled"] and (Flags["ESP/BoxEnabled"] or Flags["ESP/HealthBarEnabled"]) and char and hum and hum.Health > 0
            if shouldShow and Flags["ESP/TeamCheck"] and player.Team and LocalPlayer.Team and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
                shouldShow = false
            end
            local rootPart = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart)
            local localRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and (LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or LocalPlayer.Character.PrimaryPart)
            if shouldShow and rootPart and localRoot then
                local dist = (rootPart.Position - localRoot.Position).Magnitude
                if dist > (Flags["ESP/MaxDistance"] or 5000) then shouldShow = false end
            end
            if shouldShow then
                local ok, cf, size = pcall(function() return char:GetBoundingBox() end)
                if ok and cf and size then
                    local half = size * 0.5
                    local corners = {
                        Vector3.new(-half.X,-half.Y,-half.Z), Vector3.new(-half.X,-half.Y,half.Z),
                        Vector3.new(-half.X,half.Y,-half.Z), Vector3.new(-half.X,half.Y,half.Z),
                        Vector3.new(half.X,-half.Y,-half.Z), Vector3.new(half.X,-half.Y,half.Z),
                        Vector3.new(half.X,half.Y,-half.Z), Vector3.new(half.X,half.Y,half.Z),
                    }
                    local minX, minY, maxX, maxY = math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
                    local valid = false
                    for _, corner in ipairs(corners) do
                        local v, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(cf:PointToWorldSpace(corner))
                        if v.Z > 0 then
                            valid = true
                            minX, minY = math.min(minX, v.X), math.min(minY, v.Y)
                            maxX, maxY = math.max(maxX, v.X), math.max(maxY, v.Y)
                        end
                    end
                    if valid and maxX > minX and maxY > minY then
                        minX, minY = math.floor(minX), math.floor(minY)
                        maxX, maxY = math.floor(maxX), math.floor(maxY)
                        data.Root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(minX, minY)
                        data.Root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(2, maxX-minX), math.max(2, maxY-minY))
                        data.Root.Visible = true
                        data.Box.Visible = Flags["ESP/BoxEnabled"]
                        local color = ROLE_COLORS.Neutral
                        if Flags["ESP/ColorByRole"] then
                            local role = DetectRole(player)
                            color = ROLE_COLORS[role] or ROLE_COLORS.Unknown
                        end
                        data.Stroke.Color = color

                        local health, maxHealth = GetHealth(player)
                        local pct = math.clamp(health / math.max(maxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
                        local hpColor = GetHealthColor(health, maxHealth)
                        local barOn = Flags["ESP/HealthBarEnabled"]
                        data.HealthBG.Visible = barOn
                        data.HealthBG.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12,15,19)
                        data.HealthFill.BackgroundColor3 = hpColor
                        if Flags["ESP/HealthBarVertical"] then
                            -- Vertical bar is outside the left edge, so it never covers the box.
                            data.HealthBG.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(minX - 7, minY)
                            data.HealthBG.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, math.max(2, maxY-minY))
                            data.HealthFill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
                            data.HealthFill.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
                            data.HealthFill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, pct, 0)
                        else
                            -- Horizontal bar is below the box with a small gap.
                            data.HealthBG.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(minX, maxY + 4)
                            data.HealthBG.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(2, maxX-minX), 4)
                            data.HealthFill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
                            data.HealthFill.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
                            data.HealthFill.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0)
                        end
                    else
                        data.Root.Visible = false
                        data.HealthBG.Visible = false
                    end
                else
                    data.Root.Visible = false
                    data.HealthBG.Visible = false
                end
            else
                data.Root.Visible = false
                data.HealthBG.Visible = false
            end
        end
    end
    for player in pairs(ESP2D.Objects) do
        if not player.Parent then RemoveESP2D(player) end
    end
end

--  NOCLIP
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local Noclip = {
    Broken = {},
    BrokenCount = 0,
    OverlapParams = OverlapParams.new(),
    RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new(),
    ScratchIgnore = {},
}

Noclip.OverlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
Noclip.OverlapParams.MaxParts = 0
Noclip.RaycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
Noclip.RaycastParams.IgnoreWater = true

local _feetPartsBuffer = {}

local function GetPartsUnderFeet(char)
    table.clear(_feetPartsBuffer)
    if not char then return _feetPartsBuffer end

    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart
    if not root then return _feetPartsBuffer end

    local ignore = Noclip.ScratchIgnore
    table.clear(ignore)
    ignore[1] = char
    Noclip.RaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore

    local basePos = root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
    local direction = Vector3.new(0, -12, 0)
    local rootCF = root.CFrame

    local relOffsets = {
        Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
        Vector3.new(-1.2, 0, -1.2), Vector3.new(1.2, 0, -1.2),
        Vector3.new(-1.2, 0, 1.2),  Vector3.new(1.2, 0, 1.2),
    }

    for _, relOff in ipairs(relOffsets) do
        local origin = basePos + rootCF:VectorToWorldSpace(relOff)
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            return Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, Noclip.RaycastParams)
        end)
        if ok and result and result.Instance then
            _feetPartsBuffer[result.Instance] = true
        end
    end

    return _feetPartsBuffer
end

local function ShouldBreak(part, feetParts)
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
    if part:IsA("Terrain") then return false end
    if not part.Parent then return false end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if myChar and part:IsDescendantOf(myChar) then return false end

    local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    if model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then return false end

    if part:IsA("SpawnLocation") then return false end

    if feetParts and feetParts[part] then return false end

    local name = string.lower(part.Name)
    if name == "baseplate" or name == "ground" or name == "floor"
    or name == "terrain" or name == "base" then
        return false
    end

    if part.Size.X > 400 and part.Size.Z > 400 then return false end

    if part.Anchored then
        if not Flags["Noclip/IncludeAnchored"] then return false end
    else
        if not Flags["Noclip/IncludeUnanchored"] then return false end
    end

    return true
end

local function BreakPart(part)
    if Noclip.Broken[part] then
        if part.CanCollide then
            pcall(function() part.CanCollide = false end)
        end
        return
    end

    Noclip.Broken[part] = { cc = part.CanCollide }
    Noclip.BrokenCount = Noclip.BrokenCount + 1
    pcall(function() part.CanCollide = false end)
end

local function RestorePart(part)
    local data = Noclip.Broken[part]
    if not data then return end
    pcall(function()
        if part and part.Parent and type(data) == "table" then
            part.CanCollide = data.cc
        end
    end)
    Noclip.Broken[part] = nil
    Noclip.BrokenCount = math.max(0, Noclip.BrokenCount - 1)
end

local function RestoreAll()
    for part, data in pairs(Noclip.Broken) do
        pcall(function()
            if part and part.Parent and type(data) == "table" then
                part.CanCollide = data.cc
            end
        end)
    end
    Noclip.Broken = {}
    Noclip.BrokenCount = 0
end

local function ScanAndBreak()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart
    if not root then return end

    local radius = Flags["Noclip/Radius"] or 300
    local origin = root.Position

    local feetParts = GetPartsUnderFeet(char)

    local ignore = Noclip.ScratchIgnore
    table.clear(ignore)
    ignore[1] = char
    Noclip.OverlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore

    local ok, parts = pcall(function()
        return Workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(origin, radius, Noclip.OverlapParams)
    end)
    if not ok or not parts then return end

    for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if ShouldBreak(part, feetParts) then
            BreakPart(part)
        end
    end
end

local function EnforceNoclip()
    if next(Noclip.Broken) == nil then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart
    if not root then return end

    local feetParts = GetPartsUnderFeet(char)

    local toRemove = nil
    local toRestore = nil

    for part, _ in pairs(Noclip.Broken) do
        if not part or not part.Parent then
            toRemove = toRemove or {}
            toRemove[#toRemove + 1] = part
        elseif feetParts[part] then
            toRestore = toRestore or {}
            toRestore[#toRestore + 1] = part
        elseif part.CanCollide then
            pcall(function() part.CanCollide = false end)
        end
    end

    if toRemove then
        for _, part in ipairs(toRemove) do
            if Noclip.Broken[part] then
                Noclip.Broken[part] = nil
                Noclip.BrokenCount = math.max(0, Noclip.BrokenCount - 1)
            end
        end
    end
    if toRestore then
        for _, part in ipairs(toRestore) do
            RestorePart(part)
        end
    end
end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local AutoGive = { Running = false }

local MP5_ORIGIN_POS       = Vector3.new(813.698, 97.850, 2229.396)
local REMINGTON_ORIGIN_POS = Vector3.new(820.298, 97.850, 2229.396)
local MATCH_TOLERANCE      = 5

local TP_HEIGHT_OFFSET = 6
local TP_DWELL_TIME    = 0.8

local function FindTouchGiverByPos(targetPos)
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if obj.Name == "TouchGiver" and obj:IsA("Model") then
            local ok, pos = pcall(function()
                local primary = obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                return primary and primary.Position
            end)
            if ok and pos and (pos - targetPos).Magnitude < MATCH_TOLERANCE then
                return obj, pos
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function GetMyRoot()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart
end

local function TeleportToTouchGiver(touchPos, myRoot, homeCFrame)
    if not myRoot or not touchPos then return end

    local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(touchPos + Vector3.new(0, TP_HEIGHT_OFFSET, 0))

    pcall(function()
        myRoot.CFrame = targetCFrame
    end)

    task.wait(TP_DWELL_TIME)

    pcall(function()
        myRoot.CFrame = homeCFrame
    end)

    task.wait(0.1)
end

local function SpawnTouchGiversInFront(force)
    if not force and not Flags["AutoGive/Enabled"] then return end
    if AutoGive.Running then return end
    AutoGive.Running = true

    task.wait(1.2)

    local myRoot = GetMyRoot()
    if not myRoot then
        AutoGive.Running = false
        return
    end

    local homeCFrame = myRoot.CFrame

    local _, mp5Pos = FindTouchGiverByPos(MP5_ORIGIN_POS)
    local _, remPos = FindTouchGiverByPos(REMINGTON_ORIGIN_POS)

    if not mp5Pos and not remPos then
        AutoGive.Running = false
        return
    end

    if remPos then
        TeleportToTouchGiver(remPos, myRoot, homeCFrame)
        myRoot = GetMyRoot()
        if myRoot then homeCFrame = myRoot.CFrame end
    end

    if mp5Pos then
        TeleportToTouchGiver(mp5Pos, myRoot, homeCFrame)
    end

    local finalRoot = GetMyRoot()
    if finalRoot then
        pcall(function() finalRoot.CFrame = homeCFrame end)
    end

    AutoGive.Running = false
end

--  ARREST SYSTEM
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local ArrestState = {
    Running = false,
    SelectedPlayer = nil,
    ChaserConn = nil,
    EndTime = 0,
    HomeCFrame = nil,
    TargetRoot = nil,
}

local function GetCriminalsList()
    local out = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(GetPlayersCache()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Parent then
            local role = DetectRole(p)
            if role == "Criminal" then
                local char, root = GetCharacter(p)
                if char and root then
                    local myRoot = GetMyRoot()
                    local dist = myRoot and (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude or 0
                    table.insert(out, { player = p, dist = dist })
                end
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.dist < b.dist end)
    return out
end

local function EquipToolByName(toolName)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    if not char or not backpack then return false end

    local equipped = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if equipped and equipped.Name == toolName then return true end

    local tool = backpack:FindFirstChild(toolName)
    if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return false end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return false end

    pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(tool) end)
    return true
end

local function GetBehindCFrame(targetRoot)
    if not targetRoot then return nil end
    local dist = Flags["Arrest/StickDistance"] or 2.2
    local height = Flags["Arrest/StickHeight"] or 0.0
    return targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, height, dist)
end

local function StartChaser(targetRoot)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    local myRoot = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not myRoot or not hum then return nil end

    pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = false end)

    local chaserConn
    chaserConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local myR = LocalPlayer.Character
            and (LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or LocalPlayer.Character.PrimaryPart)
        if not myR then return end

        local behind = GetBehindCFrame(targetRoot)
        if behind then
            pcall(function()
                myR.CFrame = behind
                myR.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)
        end
    end)

    return chaserConn
end

local function StopChaser(restoreCFrame)
    if ArrestState.ChaserConn then
        pcall(function() ArrestState.ChaserConn:Disconnect() end)
        ArrestState.ChaserConn = nil
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = true end)
    end

    local myRoot = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart)
    if myRoot and restoreCFrame then
        pcall(function() myRoot.CFrame = restoreCFrame end)
    end

    ArrestState.TargetRoot = nil
    ArrestState.HomeCFrame = nil
    ArrestState.EndTime = 0
end

local function ArrestPlayer(targetPlayer)
    if not targetPlayer or not targetPlayer.Parent then return false end
    if ArrestState.Running then return false end

    ArrestState.Running = true

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and (myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or myChar.PrimaryPart)
    if not myRoot then
        ArrestState.Running = false
        return false
    end

    local homeCFrame = myRoot.CFrame

    local toolName = Flags["Arrest/ToolName"] or "Handcuffs"
    local equipped = EquipToolByName(toolName)
    if not equipped then
        Notify("Arrest", "Could not equip " .. toolName .. ". Make sure you're a Guard and have it in your backpack.")
        ArrestState.Running = false
        return false
    end

    task.wait(0.2)

    local targetChar, targetRoot = GetCharacter(targetPlayer)
    if not targetChar or not targetRoot then
        Notify("Arrest", "Target character not found.")
        pcall(function() myRoot.CFrame = homeCFrame end)
        ArrestState.Running = false
        return false
    end

    local behind = GetBehindCFrame(targetRoot)
    if behind then
        pcall(function() myRoot.CFrame = behind end)
        task.wait(0.1)
    end

    ArrestState.TargetRoot = targetRoot
    ArrestState.HomeCFrame = homeCFrame
    ArrestState.EndTime = tick() + (Flags["Arrest/StickDuration"] or 5.0)
    ArrestState.ChaserConn = StartChaser(targetRoot)

    task.spawn(function()
        while ArrestState.Running do
            task.wait(0.1)
            if tick() >= ArrestState.EndTime then
                if ArrestState.Running then
                    ArrestState.Running = false
                    StopChaser(homeCFrame)
                    Notify("Arrest", "Stick ended. You can click now or press the button again.")
                end
                break
            end
        end
    end)

    Notify("Arrest", string.format("Sticking to %s for %.1fs. Click on them to arrest!", targetPlayer.Name, Flags["Arrest/StickDuration"] or 5.0))
    return true
end

local function StopArrestStick()
    if not ArrestState.Running then return end
    ArrestState.Running = false
    StopChaser(ArrestState.HomeCFrame)
    Notify("Arrest", "Stopped sticking.")
end

    local function beginDrag(input)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = main.Position
    end
    top.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            if input.Position.X < closeBtn.AbsolutePosition.X then beginDrag(input) end
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
    end)

    local minimized = false
    local normalSize = main.Size
    State.ToggleMinimize = function()
        minimized = not minimized
        State.Minimized = minimized
        if minimized then
            normalSize = main.Size
            TweenService:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 64)}):Play()

            task.wait(0.1)
            nav.Visible = true
            workspace.Visible = true
            status.Visible = true
            closeBtn.Text = "−"
        end
    end
    closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(State.ToggleMinimize)
    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
        if gp then return end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.CapsLock then State.ToggleMinimize() end
    end)

    local finalSize = UDim2.fromOffset(780, 500)
    main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(700, 440)
    main.GroupTransparency = 1
    main.Rotation = -1.2
    uiScale.Scale = uiScale.Scale * 0.94
    local openTween = TweenService:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.58, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = finalSize,
        GroupTransparency = 0,
        Rotation = 0,
    })
    TweenService:Create(uiScale, TweenInfo.new(0.62, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = uiScale.Scale / 0.94}):Play()
    openTween:Play()
    return UI
end

    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")

    local indicator = Instance.new("Frame")
    indicator.Size = UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 0, 2)
    indicator.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
    indicator.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -2)

    local page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    page.Name = name .. "Page"
    page.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -28)
    page.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
    page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    page.BorderSizePixel = 0
    page.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    page.ScrollBarImageColor3 = THEME.Accent
    page.Visible = false
    page.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    page.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    page.Parent = State.ContentArea

    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
    layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    layout.Parent = page

    local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)
    pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8)
    pad.Parent = page

    local function select()
        for _, t in pairs(State.Tabs) do
            TweenService:Create(t.Label, TweenInfo.new(0.14), {TextColor3 = THEME.TextDark}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(t.Indicator, TweenInfo.new(0.14), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(t.Button, TweenInfo.new(0.14), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
            local existingStroke = t.Button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
            local existingScale = t.Button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
            if existingStroke then TweenService:Create(existingStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.14), {Transparency = 1}):Play() end
            if existingScale then TweenService:Create(existingScale, TweenInfo.new(0.14), {Scale = 1}):Play() end
            t.Page.Visible = false
        end
        TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.14), {TextColor3 = THEME.Text}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(indicator, TweenInfo.new(0.14), {BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.14), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.15}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(tabStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {Transparency = 0.5}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(tabScale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1.025}):Play()
        page.Visible = true
        page.Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 14)
        TweenService:Create(page, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
        }):Play()
        State.CurrentTab = name
    end
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(select)
    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        if State.CurrentTab ~= name then
            TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.16), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.55}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.16), {TextColor3 = THEME.Text}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(tabStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.16), {Transparency = 0.78}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(tabScale, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1.035}):Play()
        end
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        if State.CurrentTab ~= name then
            TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.16), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.16), {TextColor3 = THEME.TextDark}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(tabStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.16), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(tabScale, TweenInfo.new(0.16), {Scale = 1}):Play()
        end
    end)
    table.insert(State.Tabs, {Button = btn, Label = label, Indicator = indicator, Page = page, Select = select})
    if #State.Tabs == 1 then select() end
    return page
end

        State.Updaters[flag .. "/Locked"] = function(state)
            local l = state == true
            Flags[flag .. "/Locked"] = l
            SafeSet(lockBtn, "TextColor3", l and THEME.Accent or THEME.TextDark)
            SafeSet(lockBtn, "Text", l and "🔒" or "🔓")
        end

        lockBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            Flags[flag .. "/Locked"] = not Flags[flag .. "/Locked"]
            local l = Flags[flag .. "/Locked"]
            SafeSet(lockBtn, "TextColor3", l and THEME.Accent or THEME.TextDark)
            SafeSet(lockBtn, "Text", l and "🔒" or "🔓")
        end)
    end

    local inputFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    inputFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.45, -12, 0, 30)
    inputFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0)
    inputFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    inputFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 55)
    inputFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    inputFrame.Parent = frame
    local ifCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    ifCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6); ifCorner.Parent = inputFrame

    if Flags[flag] == nil and not flag:match("^Humanoid/") then
        Flags[flag] = default
    end

    local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
    box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0)
    box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 0)
    box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    box.Text = tostring(Flags[flag] ~= nil and Flags[flag] or default) .. (unit or "")
    box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    box.TextSize = 12
    box.TextColor3 = THEME.Accent
    box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    box.Parent = inputFrame

    local function commit(val, isUser)
        val = math.clamp(tonumber(val) or (Flags[flag] or default), minV, maxV)
        if step and step > 0 then
            val = math.floor(val / step + 0.5) * step
        end
        Flags[flag] = val
        box.Text = tostring(val) .. (unit or "")
        if isUser then
            if callback then pcall(callback, val) end
        end
    end

    State.Updaters[flag] = function(val)
        if not box:IsFocused() then
            val = math.clamp(tonumber(val) or default, minV, maxV)
            box.Text = tostring(val) .. (unit or "")
            if callback then pcall(callback, val) end
        end
    end

    box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        commit((box.Text:gsub("[^%d%.%-]", "")), true)
    end)

    local minus = Instance.new("TextButton")
    minus.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 1, 0)
    minus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    minus.Text = "−"
    minus.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

    minus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() commit((Flags[flag] or default) - (step or 1), true) end)

    local plus = Instance.new("TextButton")

    plus.TextSize = 16
    plus.TextColor3 = THEME.TextDark

        TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.16), {Transparency = 0.02, Thickness = 1.35}):Play()

    end)

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

        task.wait(0.06)

        if callback then pcall(callback) end
    end)

--  HITBOX EXPANDER MODULE (adapted from supplied logic)
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local HitboxState = { Original = {}, Hooks = {} }

local function HitboxRemember(part)
    if not HitboxState.Original[part] then
        HitboxState.Original[part] = {Size = part.Size, Transparency = part.Transparency}
    end
end

local function HitboxRestoreCharacter(char)
    if not char then return end
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        local original = HitboxState.Original[part]
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and original then
            pcall(function() part.Size = original.Size; part.Transparency = original.Transparency end)
            HitboxState.Original[part] = nil
        end
    end
    local viz = char:FindFirstChild("AxiomHitboxViz")
    if viz then viz:Destroy() end
end

local function HitboxApplyCharacter(char)
    if not Flags["Hitbox/Enabled"] or not char then return end
    local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
    if not player or (player == LocalPlayer and not Flags["Hitbox/IncludeSelf"]) then return end
    local parts = {}
    if Flags["Hitbox/AllParts"] then
        for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then table.insert(parts, part) end
        end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then table.insert(parts, hrp) end
    else
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then table.insert(parts, hrp) end
    end
    for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
        HitboxRemember(part)
        pcall(function()
            part.Size = Vector3.new(Flags["Hitbox/Size"], Flags["Hitbox/Size"], Flags["Hitbox/Size"])
            part.Transparency = Flags["Hitbox/Transparency"]
        end)
    end
    local viz = char:FindFirstChild("AxiomHitboxViz")
    if Flags["Hitbox/Visualizer"] then
        if not viz then
            viz = Instance.new("Highlight")
            viz.Name = "AxiomHitboxViz"
            viz.FillColor = THEME.Accent
            viz.FillTransparency = 0.55
            viz.OutlineColor = THEME.Accent
            viz.OutlineTransparency = 0.05
            viz.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            viz.Adornee = char
            viz.Parent = char
        end
    elseif viz then viz:Destroy() end
end

local function HitboxRestoreAll()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then HitboxRestoreCharacter(player.Character) end
    end
    for part, original in pairs(HitboxState.Original) do
        if part and part.Parent then
            pcall(function() part.Size = original.Size; part.Transparency = original.Transparency end)
        end
    end
    table.clear(HitboxState.Original)
end

local function HitboxRefreshAll()
    HitboxRestoreAll()
    if Flags["Hitbox/Enabled"] then
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player.Character then HitboxApplyCharacter(player.Character) end
        end
    end
end

local function HitboxSetEnabled(enabled)
    Flags["Hitbox/Enabled"] = enabled
    if enabled then
        HitboxRefreshAll()
        Notify("Hitbox", "Hitbox expander enabled.")
    else
        HitboxRestoreAll()
        Notify("Hitbox", "Original hitboxes restored.")
    end
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        task.wait(0.35)
        if Flags["Hitbox/Enabled"] then HitboxApplyCharacter(char) end
    end)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        task.wait(0.35)
        if Flags["Hitbox/Enabled"] then HitboxApplyCharacter(char) end
    end)
end)

local function RefreshGotoPlayers()
    for _, ch in ipairs(playersListFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if not ch:IsA("UIListLayout") then ch:Destroy() end
    end

    local myRoot = GetMyRoot()
    local myPos = myRoot and myRoot.Position or Vector3.zero

    local groups = {
        Guard = {},
        Inmate = {},
        Criminal = {},
        Neutral = {},
        Unknown = {},
    }

    for _, p in ipairs(GetPlayersCache()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Parent then
            local char, root = GetCharacter(p)
            if char and root then
                local role = DetectRole(p)
                if not groups[role] then role = "Unknown" end
                local dist = (root.Position - myPos).Magnitude
                table.insert(groups[role], {player = p, dist = dist})
            end
        end
    end

    local order = 1

    for _, roleName in ipairs({"Guard", "Inmate", "Criminal", "Neutral", "Unknown"}) do
        if RoleFilter[roleName] then
            local list = groups[roleName]
            table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.dist < b.dist end)

            if #list > 0 then
                -- Header
                local header = Instance.new("Frame")
                header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
                header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                header.LayoutOrder = order
                header.Parent = playersListFrame
                order = order + 1

                local hLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                hLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                hLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0)
                hLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                hLbl.Text = string.format("%s  (%d)", string.upper(roleName), #list)
                hLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
                hLbl.TextSize = 11
                hLbl.TextColor3 = ROLE_COLORS[roleName]
                hLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                hLbl.Parent = header

                for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
                    local p = entry.player
                    local dist = math.floor(entry.dist)

                    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
                    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
                    row.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Element
                    row.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    row.LayoutOrder = order
                    row.Parent = playersListFrame
                    order = order + 1

                    local rCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
                    rCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6); rCorner.Parent = row

                    -- Left color bar
                    local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
                    bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -8)
                    bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
                    bar.BackgroundColor3 = ROLE_COLORS[roleName]
                    bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    bar.Parent = row
                    local barCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
                    barCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0); barCorner.Parent = bar

                    local nameLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    nameLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 18)
                    nameLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 3)
                    nameLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    nameLbl.Text = p.DisplayName or p.Name
                    nameLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                    nameLbl.TextSize = 12
                    nameLbl.TextColor3 = ROLE_COLORS[roleName]
                    nameLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                    nameLbl.Parent = row

                    local subLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    subLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 14)
                    subLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 22)
                    subLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    subLbl.Text = string.format("@%s  |  %d studs", p.Name, dist)
                    subLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                    subLbl.TextSize = 10
                    subLbl.TextColor3 = THEME.TextDark
                    subLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                    subLbl.Parent = row

                    local goBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                    goBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 84, 0, 28)
                    goBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0.5, -14)
                    goBtn.BackgroundColor3 = ROLE_COLORS[roleName]
                    goBtn.Text = "GOTO"
                    goBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
                    goBtn.TextSize = 11
                    goBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 22)
                    goBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    goBtn.Parent = row
                    local gCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
                    gCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6); gCorner.Parent = goBtn

                    goBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                        local char, root = GetCharacter(p)
                        if char and root then
                            local behindPos = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 3)
                            TeleportToPosition(behindPos)
                        else
                            Notify("Go-To", "Player has no character.")
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Empty state
    local anyVisible = false
    for _, roleName in ipairs({"Guard", "Inmate", "Criminal", "Neutral", "Unknown"}) do
        if RoleFilter[roleName] and #groups[roleName] > 0 then
            anyVisible = true
            break
        end
    end

    if not anyVisible then
        local emptyLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        emptyLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
        emptyLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        emptyLbl.Text = "No players match the current filter."
        emptyLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        emptyLbl.TextSize = 11
        emptyLbl.TextColor3 = THEME.TextDark
        emptyLbl.LayoutOrder = 1
        emptyLbl.Parent = playersListFrame
    end
end

local function MakeArrestNumericRow(labelText, flag, default, minV, maxV, step, unit, order)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Element
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.LayoutOrder = order

    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6); c.Parent = frame

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.55, -12, 1, 0)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = labelText
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    lbl.TextSize = 12
    lbl.TextColor3 = THEME.Text
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Parent = frame

    if Flags[flag] == nil then Flags[flag] = default end

    local inputFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    inputFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.45, -12, 0, 30)
    inputFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0)
    inputFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    inputFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 55)
    inputFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    inputFrame.Parent = frame
    local ifc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    ifc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6); ifc.Parent = inputFrame

    local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
    box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0)
    box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 0)
    box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    box.Text = tostring(Flags[flag]) .. (unit or "")
    box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    box.TextSize = 12
    box.TextColor3 = THEME.Accent
    box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    box.Parent = inputFrame

    local function commit(val)
        val = math.clamp(tonumber(val) or Flags[flag], minV, maxV)
        if step and step > 0 then
            val = math.floor(val / step + 0.5) * step
        end
        Flags[flag] = val
        box.Text = tostring(val) .. (unit or "")
    end

    box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        commit((box.Text:gsub("[^%d%.%-]", "")))
    end)

    local minus = Instance.new("TextButton")
    minus.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 1, 0)
    minus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    minus.Text = "−"
    minus.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    minus.TextSize = 16
    minus.TextColor3 = THEME.TextDark
    minus.Parent = inputFrame
    minus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() commit(Flags[flag] - (step or 1)) end)

    local plus = Instance.new("TextButton")
    plus.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 1, 0)
    plus.Position = UDim2.new(1, -25, 0, 0)
    plus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    plus.Text = "+"
    plus.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    plus.TextSize = 16
    plus.TextColor3 = THEME.TextDark
    plus.Parent = inputFrame
    plus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() commit(Flags[flag] + (step or 1)) end)
end

    if capturingKeybind then
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
            local id = capturingKeybind
            if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then
                Keybinds[id] = nil
                keybindButtons[id].Text = "NONE"

        end
        return
    end
    if gp then return end
    for _, entry in ipairs(KeybindTargets) do
        if Keybinds[entry.Id] and input.KeyCode == Keybinds[entry.Id] then
            local newState = not Flags[entry.Flag]
            if entry.Id == "Hitbox" then
                if State.Updaters[entry.Flag] then State.Updaters[entry.Flag](newState) else HitboxSetEnabled(newState) end
            else
                Flags[entry.Flag] = newState
                if State.Updaters[entry.Flag] then State.Updaters[entry.Flag](newState) end
                if entry.Id == "Aim" and not newState then ClearAimLockState(true) end
                if entry.Id == "Noclip" and not newState then RestoreAll() end
                if entry.Id == "ESP" and not newState then
                    for _, data in pairs(ESP.Objects) do
                        SafeSet(data.Nametag, "Enabled", false)
                        if data.Highlight then SafeSet(data.Highlight, "Enabled", false) end

                end
                Notify(entry.Name, newState and "Enabled" or "Disabled")
            end
            break
        end

end)

    task.wait(0.5)
    pcall(RefreshArrestList)
end

        CaptureHumanoidSettings()
        task.wait(0.3)
        ApplySavedHumanoidSettings()
        if Flags["AutoGive/Enabled"] then
            SpawnTouchGiversInFront()
        end
        task.wait(0.5)
        pcall(RefreshArrestList)
    end)
end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  MAIN LOOPS
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local lastESPUpdate = 0
local ESP_UPDATE_INTERVAL = 0.1
local lastNoclipScan = 0
local NOCLIP_SCAN_INTERVAL = 0.75
local lastNoclipEnforce = 0
local NOCLIP_ENFORCE_INTERVAL = 0.2
local lastCharCachePrune = 0
local CHAR_CACHE_PRUNE_INTERVAL = 5.0
local lastHumanoidEnforce = 0
local HUMANOID_ENFORCE_INTERVAL = 0.1

local function PruneCharCache()
    local now = os.clock()
    if (now - lastCharCachePrune) < CHAR_CACHE_PRUNE_INTERVAL then return end
    lastCharCachePrune = now

    local playerMap = {}
    for i = 1, #cachedPlayersList do
        playerMap[cachedPlayersList[i]] = true
    end

    for player, cache in pairs(CharCache) do
        if not playerMap[player] or not player.Parent then
            if AimState.LastAimTarget == player then
                ClearAimLockState(false)
            end
            cache.Char = nil
            cache.Root = nil
            cache.Humanoid = nil
            cache.Head = nil
            CharCache[player] = nil
        elseif cache.Char and not cache.Char.Parent then
            if AimState.LastAimTarget == player then
                ClearAimLockState(false)
            end
            cache.Char = nil
            cache.Root = nil
            cache.Humanoid = nil
            cache.Head = nil
        end
    end
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local now = tick()

    if now - lastESPUpdate >= ESP_UPDATE_INTERVAL then
        lastESPUpdate = now
        if Flags["ESP/Enabled"] then
            RefreshESP()
        end
    end

    if Flags["Noclip/Enabled"] then
        if now - lastNoclipScan >= NOCLIP_SCAN_INTERVAL then
            lastNoclipScan = now
            ScanAndBreak()
        end
        if now - lastNoclipEnforce >= NOCLIP_ENFORCE_INTERVAL then
            lastNoclipEnforce = now
            EnforceNoclip()
        end
    end

    if now - lastHumanoidEnforce >= HUMANOID_ENFORCE_INTERVAL then
        lastHumanoidEnforce = now
        ApplyHumanoidSettings()
    end

    PruneCharCache()
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    UpdateAim()
    UpdateESP2D()
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.5) do
        if Flags["Hitbox/Enabled"] then
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                local char = player.Character
                local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp and math.abs(hrp.Size.X - Flags["Hitbox/Size"]) > 0.1 then
                    HitboxApplyCharacter(char)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  CLEANUP
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function Axiom_Unload()
    if ArrestState.Running then
        StopArrestStick()
    end
    RestoreAll()
    ClearAimLockState(true)

    for p, _ in pairs(ESP.Objects) do RemoveNametag(p) end
    for p, _ in pairs(ESP2D.Objects) do RemoveESP2D(p) end
    if ESP2D.Gui then SafeDestroy(ESP2D.Gui) end
    HitboxSetEnabled(false)
    if ESP.Folder then SafeDestroy(ESP.Folder) end
    if NotifyGui then SafeDestroy(NotifyGui) end
    if FovCircleGui then SafeDestroy(FovCircleGui) end
    if State.ScreenGui then SafeDestroy(State.ScreenGui) end

    table.clear(CharCache)
    table.clear(CandidateList)

    print("[Axiom] Unloaded.")
end

_G.Axiom_Unload = Axiom_Unload

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  READY
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print(string.format("[Axiom v%s] Loaded successfully.", VERSION))
print("[Axiom] Press CapsLock to minimize/restore.")
print("[Axiom] Unload: _G.Axiom_Unload()")

Notify("Axiom", "Loaded! Aim, ESP, Noclip, Teleport, Go-To, Auto-Give, Humanoid, Arrest ready.")

scripts.script:
--// THE FLASH (BARRY ALLEN) - POLISHED HUD + COMIC-STYLE LIGHTNING WAKE
--// CONTROLS: HOLD E = ACCELERATE | HOLD Q = BRAKE | WASD = STEER | Z = HUD | F9 = RESET | F10 = CLOSE
--// 400+: straight speed beams plus a long, thin, jagged comic-style lightning wake.
--// Limb (arm/foot) Trails removed. Side/ahead light beams are unchanged.
--// 1,400+: cinematic lighting. 2,000+: pose echoes and phasing. 5,000+: dark gold time-rift corridor.
--// Speed has no configured cap (math.huge); world movement remains subject to Roblox engine limits.
--// Client-side LocalScript. Time-rift and slow-motion are visual illusions only.

local F = {}
local function __BarryAllenStart()
F.Players = game:GetService("Players")
F.UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
F.ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
F.RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
F.Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
F.TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
F.Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
F.SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
for _, oldMusic in ipairs(F.SoundService:GetChildren()) do
    if oldMusic.Name == "BarryAllenMyOrdinaryLifeMusic" then
        pcall(function() oldMusic:Stop(); oldMusic:Destroy() end)
    end
end

F.Player = F.Players.LocalPlayer
F.PlayerGui = F.Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
F.Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
F.CameraBindName = "BarryAllenSpeedForceCamera_" .. tostring(F.Player.UserId)
F.AccelActionName = "BarryAllenHoldAccel_" .. tostring(F.Player.UserId)
F.BrakeActionName = "BarryAllenHoldBrake_" .. tostring(F.Player.UserId)

--==================================================
-- CLEAN UP PREVIOUS RUN
--==================================================

if _G.WallySpeedForceCleanup then
	pcall(_G.WallySpeedForceCleanup)
end

F.Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
F.OriginalCameraFOV = (F.Camera and F.Camera.FieldOfView) or 70

for _, name in ipairs({
	"WallyWestSpeedForceHUD",
	"BarryAllenSpeedForceHUD",
	"BarryAllenStartupError",
	"WallyCinematicSpeedTunnel",
	"WallyCinematicColorGrade",
	"WallyCinematicBloom",
	"BarryAllenCinematicColorGrade",
	"BarryAllenCinematicBloom",
	"BarryAllenTimeRiftGrade",
	"BarryAllenTimeRiftBloom",
}) do
	local item = F.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild(name) or F.Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
	if item then
		item:Destroy()
	end
end

for _, folderName in ipairs({"WallyWest_LocalVFX", "BarryAllen_LocalVFX"}) do
	local oldVFX = workspace:FindFirstChild(folderName)
	if oldVFX then oldVFX:Destroy() end
end

local legacyEffectNames = {
    BarryCinematicShockwave = true,
    BarrySonicCondensationFlash = true,
    BarrySonicPressureFront = true,
    BarrySonicMachConeAnchor = true,
    BarrySonicCondensationPuff = true,
    BarrySonicChargeLight = true,
    BarrySonicChargeSparkAttachment = true,
    BarrySonicPressureSparks = true,
    BarrySonicChargeA0 = true,
    BarrySonicChargeA1 = true,
    BarrySpeedHaloArc = true,
}
for _, rootToScan in ipairs({F.Player.Character}) do
    if rootToScan then
        for _, object in ipairs(rootToScan:GetDescendants()) do
            local name = object.Name
            if legacyEffectNames[name]
                or string.match(name, "^BarrySpeedHaloA[01]_")
                or string.match(name, "^BarryTimelineRingA[01]_")
                or string.match(name, "^BarryLimbTrailA[01]_")
                or string.match(name, "^BarryLimbLightTrail_")
                or name == "WallyShockwave" then
                pcall(function() object:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end
end

F.Running = true
F.Connections = {}
F.Cleanup = nil
F.Character = nil
F.Humanoid = nil
F.Root = nil

F.Connect = function(signal, callback)
	local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
	table.insert(F.Connections, connection)
	return connection
end

--==================================================
-- COLORS
--==================================================

F.RED = Color3.fromRGB(210, 15, 25)
F.BRIGHT_RED = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 50)
F.DARK_RED = Color3.fromRGB(70, 5, 10)
F.YELLOW = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 35)
F.GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(255, 145, 15)
F.WHITE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
F.BLACK = Color3.fromRGB(7, 7, 9)
F.DARK = Color3.fromRGB(17, 17, 21)
F.GREY = Color3.fromRGB(135, 135, 145)

--==================================================
-- SPEED SETTINGS
--==================================================

F.Speed = 0
F.MaxSpeed = math.huge
F.Acceleration = 450
F.Deceleration = 800

F.HoldingE = false
F.HoldingQ = false
F.HoldingW = false
F.HoldingA = false
F.HoldingS = false
F.HoldingD = false

F.WasCinematicSpeed = false
F.HUDVisible = true

F.RUN_MUSIC_ASSET_ID = "rbxassetid://1199443456"
F.RUN_MUSIC_TARGET_VOLUME = 0.34
F.RUN_MUSIC_FADE_IN = 1.6
F.RUN_MUSIC_FADE_OUT = 2.2
F.RUN_MUSIC_MIN_SPEED = 20
F.RunMusic = Instance.new("Sound")
F.RunMusic.Name = "BarryAllenMyOrdinaryLifeMusic"
F.RunMusic.SoundId = F.RUN_MUSIC_ASSET_ID
F.RunMusic.Looped = true
F.RunMusic.Volume = 0
F.RunMusic.PlaybackSpeed = 1
F.RunMusic.Parent = F.SoundService
F.RunMusicLastPlayAttempt = 0

F.UpdateRunMusic = function(deltaTime, moving)
    if not F.RunMusic or not F.RunMusic.Parent then return end
    local shouldPlay = moving and F.Speed >= F.RUN_MUSIC_MIN_SPEED
    if shouldPlay then
        if not F.RunMusic.IsPlaying and (os.clock() - F.RunMusicLastPlayAttempt) > 8.0 then
            F.RunMusicLastPlayAttempt = os.clock()
            pcall(function() F.RunMusic:Play() end)
        end
        local blend = 1 - math.exp(-deltaTime * F.RUN_MUSIC_FADE_IN)
        F.RunMusic.Volume = F.RunMusic.Volume + (F.RUN_MUSIC_TARGET_VOLUME - F.RunMusic.Volume) * blend
    else
        F.RunMusic.Volume = math.max(0, F.RunMusic.Volume - deltaTime * F.RUN_MUSIC_FADE_OUT)
        if F.RunMusic.Volume <= 0.008 and F.RunMusic.IsPlaying then
            pcall(function() F.RunMusic:Stop() end)
        end
    end
end

F.SPEED_BEAM_START_SPEED = 400

F.REALITY_WARP_THRESHOLD = 2000

--==================================================
-- GUI HELPERS
--==================================================

F.MakeLabel = function(parent, name, size, position, text, color, font, textSize, zIndex)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = name
	label.Size = size
	label.Position = position
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.Font = font
	label.TextSize = textSize
	label.ZIndex = zIndex or 8
	label.Parent = parent
	return label
end

--==================================================
-- HUD
--==================================================

F.Main.ZIndex = 2

F.AddCorner(F.Main, 18)

F.MainGradient.Rotation = 12

    if not F.Main.Parent then return end

    y = math.clamp(y, 0, math.max(0, viewport.Y - F.Main.AbsoluteSize.Y))
    F.Main.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)

        math.clamp(x + 7, 0, math.max(0, viewport.X - F.Shadow.AbsoluteSize.X)),
        math.clamp(y + 8, 0, math.max(0, viewport.Y - F.Shadow.AbsoluteSize.Y))

end)

F.Connect(F.Header.InputChanged, function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		F.DragInput = input
	end
end)

F.Connect(F.UIS.InputChanged, function(input)
	if F.Dragging and input == F.DragInput then
		local delta = input.Position - F.DragStart
		local newPosition = UDim2.new(
			F.StartPos.X.Scale,
			F.StartPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			F.StartPos.Y.Scale,
			F.StartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera or F.Camera
        local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
        local pixelX = viewport.X * newPosition.X.Scale + newPosition.X.Offset
        local pixelY = viewport.Y * newPosition.Y.Scale + newPosition.Y.Offset
        local maxX = math.max(0, viewport.X - F.Main.AbsoluteSize.X)
        local maxY = math.max(0, viewport.Y - F.Main.AbsoluteSize.Y)
        pixelX = math.clamp(pixelX, 0, maxX)
        pixelY = math.clamp(pixelY, 0, maxY)
        newPosition = UDim2.fromOffset(pixelX, pixelY)

		F.Main.Position = newPosition
		F.Shadow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
            math.clamp(pixelX + 7, 0, maxX),
            math.clamp(pixelY + 8, 0, maxY)
        )
	end
end)

        F.TelemetryTag, F.ControlTag, F.ControlHint,

		F.HideButton.Text = "OPEN"

end
